title: Goods in Administrator
company: MET Recruitment UK LTD - Agency - Permanent
description:
Goods In Administrator

Location: Wolverhampton
Job Type: Full Time, Temp to Perm
Pay Rate: £12.90 per hour

We are currently recruiting for a Goods In Administrator to join a busy team based in Wolverhampton. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who is organised, reliable and confident working in a fast-paced warehouse environment.

The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting the smooth running of the goods-in and goods-out process, ensuring stock and deliveries are accurately recorded and processed.

Key Responsibilities
- Booking in goods and deliveries received into the site
- Recording and processing incoming goods accurately
- Booking out goods and ensuring outgoing items are correctly processed
- Updating relevant systems and maintaining accurate records
- Checking paperwork and delivery information
- Liaising with warehouse and operational teams to ensure goods are processed efficiently
- Supporting other areas of the warehouse/operation during quieter periods
- Carrying out general administrative and operational duties as required
- Following company procedures and maintaining a high level of accuracy at all times

About You

We are looking for someone who is:
- Organised and detail-oriented
- Reliable and punctual
- Comfortable working in a busy environment
- Confident using computer systems and completing administrative tasks
- Able to work well as part of a team
- Flexible and willing to support other areas when required
- Previous experience in a goods-in, warehouse administration, logistics or similar role is essential.

What's on Offer
- £12.90 per hour
- Full-time hours
- Temp-to-perm opportunity
- Opportunity to develop within a busy operational environment
- Supportive team environment

Interested?

If you are interested in this opportunity, please get in touch with Tegan Young at (url removed) to find out more or apply.

title: Vehicle Sales Administrator
description:
Vehicle Sales Administrator

Location : Tipton

Hours : Monday - Friday (Apply online only)

Salary 26500

Vehicle Sales Administrator

To manage the administration and coordination of bodywork repair activity, ensuring quality, cost control, and timely vehicle return to service.

Key Responsibilities

Coordinate bodywork repair jobs from intake to completion

Liaise with bodyshops, insurers, and suppliers to progress repairs

Manage estimates, approvals, and invoicing in line with agreed processes

Track vehicle status and update systems accurately

Ensure photographic evidence and documentation are captured and stored correctly

Monitor repair quality and escalate concerns where standards are not met

Support reporting on repair volumes, costs, and turnaround times
